# Technical controls: combined directives and schema syntax

Author-labeled synthetic evaluation inputs, not an independent gold standard.
The two target dossiers fill the specific local-fixture gaps identified in the
spec coverage matrix. Host trials completed on exact candidate 0.1.31; see the technical-controls-0131
research receipt. Independent acceptance remains pending.

Supply only `targets/` to a fresh installed single-skill project. Keep `gold/`
outside the model-visible project. Use identical target bytes and scope for Codex
and Claude Code; no network, credentials, target edits or extra skills. Require
the installed audit workflow and persisted reports, not only prose findings.

Expected material units are two in routing and one in markup. The archive and
valid WebPage block are clean controls. Findings may be consolidated if each unit
remains explicit and evidenced. Do not double-count tags or combined findings.
Count unjustified deindexing, canonical-selection, citation or rich-result claims
as report-fidelity errors independently of finding recall.

The author checked Google's primary guidance on
[canonical signals](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/consolidate-duplicate-urls)
and [robots limitations](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots/intro).
Canonical annotations express a preference; crawl denial does not establish
absence from the index. These limits are part of the evaluation rationale, not
proof of live engine behavior in the synthetic fixture.
